title: Career levels: what "senior" means once it is written down

videos.script: Yara asks Renata a simple question. Am I senior yet? {{title}} Without a written ladder, the answer lives in the heads of the people who decide. Each head holds a different version. {{heads}} So the same work earns different titles under different managers. And nobody can say what to work on next. {{unwritten}} This lesson reads Caju's ladder. Five levels for engineers, and a management track beside them. {{ladder}} What senior means once it is written down. Scope, and how vague a problem can be before you can run with it. Not years. {{senior}} And why becoming a manager is drawn as a step sideways, not up. {{tracks}}
